data.narrative:
SkySafe, a Series B-stage defense and security technology company founded by Grant Jordan, has raised $50M+ to date. Valuation analysis draws on a comparable set of 10 peers spanning 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms operating in the same sector and stage cohort.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression modeling, using total raised as a proxy base ($50M) and applying a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical for Series B advancement, yields $95M. Peer-median analysis across 7 same-sector, same-stage comparables—including Dream Security ($3.0B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B), Code Metal ($1.2B), Castelion ($1.0B), and Defense Unicorns ($1.0B)—produces a median valuation of $1.0B, with a range of $300M to $3.0B.

Triangulating these methods yields a valuation range of $81M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $548M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty regarding SkySafe's relative positioning within the peer cohort. Key variables include revenue traction, customer concentration, IP defensibility, and product-market fit maturity relative to the identified comparables. Stage-progression suggests a more conservative floor; peer-median anchors to market precedent but relies on the assumption of reasonable peer comparability on growth trajectory and strategic importance.
